_comment: Planned --detail payload for node listAadGroups1 (List AAD Groups). Connector key: uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory. No-live-tenant sandbox: connectionId and folderKey are filled from the registered connection discovered via 'uip is connections list'. The 'filter' block is the structured FilterBuilder tree passed to 'uip maestro flow node configure --detail'. The CLI compiles it to the runtime CEQL string (queryParameters.where) and the design-time AST (savedFilterTrees.where) in lockstep.

filter._comment: Passed as --detail.filter to 'uip maestro flow node configure'. CLI compiles to CEQL: displayName = 'active'. The FilterBuilder parameter name is 'where' (from connectorMethodInfo.parameters[].name where design.component == 'FilterBuilder'). The field 'displayName' is filterable (searchableOperators: ['=', 'IN']). Operator 'Equals' compiles to CEQL '='.
